create_attention_head: create an AttentionHead with query-key bilinear and output-linear projections for transformer attention
build_multi_attention_head: build a MultiAttentionHead that applies multiple attention heads in parallel over a sequence
create_mlp_block: create an MLP block with two linear layers and ReLU activation for transformer feed-forward
combine_mlps_in_parallel: combine multiple MLP blocks in parallel using the combine_in_parallel class method
build_series_with_residuals: build a SeriesWithResiduals that chains half-layer blocks with residual connections
